lens: Fictionalized Prof. Margaret Morse lens: inhabited systems

evidence.criterion: Visible interdisciplinary threshold and role clarity
evidence.finding: Home names the technical project management/product operations role immediately. About is one primary-navigation click away and opens with the same role before 'Systems people can inhabit'. The Open House lineage then explicitly connects artistic, civic, technical and social practice; it is a concise threshold, not an artist biography.

WOWList makes scene vocabulary and shared calendars into editable event text, keyword communities and organizer distribution. Sunday Dinner/196 makes hospitality, orientation, independent access and return into two visibly labeled handoff reconstructions while withholding participant values. Coalition work connects invitation, participatory naming/letter-making, the working room, a shared campaign site and later meetings. KC adds an unusually concrete relationship between a public service promise and the inhabited street where delivery occurred.

evidence.criterion: Why this is not conventional administration
evidence.finding: The structures let people enter, influence, remember and continue: organizers write in their own community language; coalition participants can name and edit; resident artists retain agency; continuity records protect rather than expose relationships. These are operational choices tied to public examples, not generic values.

The rendered homepage uses a full photographic threshold with readable role text and credit, not a dashboard. The About page uses editorial typography and rule-separated examples. The KC matched images are evidence of one change in a real place, with precise captions and limited conclusions. The coalition and shared-table photographic records connect the digital surface with bodies, attention and place; registered photo metadata marks authorized placements while production/indexing remain open.

Open House is a short canonical claim grounded in a dated public article; the public-safe source note explicitly withholds raw educational records, private correspondence and unapproved testimonial material. Richard Caceres and organizer communities retain WOWList credit. Coalition outcomes remain collective. Sunday Dinner publishes schema-level reconstructions, not participant rows. HJE dates and 196 planning-vs-completed-residency distinction are explicit.

gaps.finding: Some operating detail is necessarily a redacted reconstruction. The 196 template is not proof of a completed residency and the protected aggregate is not a precise attendance census; the candidate states these limits.

The About page is long after its concise opening. Its subheadings and linked examples keep the argument navigable, but an additional summary could improve scanning. This is not needed to satisfy this lens.
This reader did not rerun mobile, source-exclusion, metadata or full publication-gate checks. Those independent gates remain required.
